dayLines: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
📨 Word came: Miguel Santos wants to join Haven. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to try." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📓 Journal: Miguel Santos applied remotely.
"Hey." A woman, maybe 20s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 20s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A man, maybe 50s is showing A man, maybe 60s, with a shaved head how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
★ IDENTIFIED: Water Lily. Floating leaves, showy flowers. The tubers and seeds are food — cooked. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
A man, maybe 30s, with freckles brought you a sample. The Journal grows.
A person, maybe 60s: "a tree with orange fruit, soft when ripe is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Ilse and Bill lingered over the fire together.
Emiliano and Ilse lingered over the fire together.
Daniyar and Ilse lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Fire-hardened spear at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
